questions.stem: Why does the amount of energy decrease at each trophic level in a food chain?

options.text: Because organisms at higher levels eat less food
Because energy is lost through respiration, excretion, and as heat at each level
Because the Sun provides less energy to higher levels

questions.explanation: At each trophic level, energy is lost to the environment through respiration (as heat), in excretory products (urine and faeces), and in uneaten parts. Only about 10% of energy is passed to the next level.
